classification.difficultyReason: Select the appropriate branch for three inputs, evaluate each value, then combine them in the given expression using exact fraction arithmetic.

content.prompt:
Consider the following piecewise-defined function.
$$f(x)=\begin{cases}x+3,&x<-1\\x^2,&-1\leq x\leq1\\\sqrt{x},&x>1\end{cases}$$
Evaluate
$$3f(4)+f(-2)-f\left(-\frac12\right).$$

answer.worked:
Use the formula for the interval containing each input:
$$\begin{align*}f(4)&=\sqrt4\\f(4)&=2\\f(-2)&=-2+3\\f(-2)&=1\\f\left(-\frac12\right)&=\left(-\frac12\right)^2\\f\left(-\frac12\right)&=\frac14.\end{align*}$$
Hence
$$\begin{align*}3f(4)+f(-2)-f\left(-\frac12\right)&=3(2)+1-\frac14\\3f(4)+f(-2)-f\left(-\frac12\right)&=\frac{27}{4}.\end{align*}$$
